column1: # QR codes in real photos (docs/build.md, "Text in photos"): 6 images from Wikimedia Commons, all marked CC0 or public domain, fetched by
# scripts/fetch-ocr-set.sh next to the text set. `present` is how many codes a person can see; the last column is the payloads a
# reader must decode (empty: none of the decoders tried read them; they stay here so a better reader shows up as a better number).
